item.text: {"issues":[{"coherent":"yes","description":"Users report that recent changes make playlists harder to view and control, with unwanted recommendations or shuffle replacing selected songs and ordered playback.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_USABILITY_04","issue_name":"Playlist access and playback controls"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Reviews complain that frequent or excessive advertisements disrupt use of the app.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_USABILITY_05","issue_name":"Frequent advertisements"},{"coherent":"no","description":"The examples span unrelated playback restrictions and bugs, podcast promotion and controls, audio volume inconsistency, pop-ups, and general reliability complaints.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["2840a5ee-6459-406b-9c64-53da7b012b46","560544f9-f12d-4527-8ad7-f313ec179cc4","b1a0d0e4-bd80-49f6-b775-18f304fad915","fc0a4a68-3231-40a1-9be1-64e3b105bb42","f09a593b-e940-4118-9ff5-86b54efa0b6d"],"issue_id":"I_USABILITY_06","issue_name":"Mixed app usability complaints"},{"coherent":"no","description":"Most examples complain about frequent advertisements, but a few instead concern shuffle and skip limits or widget customization.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["1b40d4d8-869d-4815-a764-fb9c1e66c8d4","7a03e0ab-6d7c-4c0d-84e6-5f0e7dc27015"],"issue_id":"I_USABILITY_07","issue_name":"Mostly frequent advertisements"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Users say playback restrictions prevent them from selecting, sequencing, repeating, seeking within, or skipping to the songs they want.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_PLAYBACK_01","issue_name":"Restrictions on song playback"}]}
